detail.title: Operational Criteria for Physical Causal Memory
detail.summary: Physical memory functions as an operational causal state when internal degrees of freedom enable predictive control over future system dynamics. This relationship is fundamentally limited by coarse-graining, which restricts access to exact Markovian trajectories and necessitates lower-bound inference on entropy production.
detail.reason: Revision to integrate coarse-graining limits on causal inference and predictive sufficiency.

detail.title: Operational Foundations of Causal Memory (Revised)
detail.summary: Persistent physical states function as operational memory only when they provide predictive sufficiency relative to a specified coarse-graining scale. The thermodynamic maintenance of these states—specifically erasure and retention—is modulated by nonequilibrium conditions, including nonreciprocal couplings and potential energy differences between reservoirs.
detail.reason: Revision necessary to synthesize new thermodynamic evidence regarding information engines and renormalization group approaches to coarse-graining.

detail.title: Operational Foundations of Causal Memory
detail.question: When does a persistent physical state function as memory by improving predictions or altering future control?
detail.reason: Previous revisions established the dependency on coarse-graining; the next logical step is to bridge the reconstruction accuracy with energy dissipation.

detail.title: Operational Foundations of Causal Memory (Revised)
detail.summary: This notebook synthesizes the criteria for causal memory, establishing that a persistent state only functions as memory when it provides predictive sufficiency or control utility relative to a specific coarse-grained model. Physical memory systems are bounded by the information-theoretic cost of maintaining these states against dissipation, with non-driven passive degrees of freedom modifying the effective entropy production rate.
detail.reason: Integrating new findings on coarse-graining and Langevin dynamics refines the operational criteria.
